rapport_notes: Professional and thorough with a third-party move coordinator; handled being questioned about the need for square footage gracefully. Transactional/B2B tone throughout rather than personal warmth.
top_strength: Carefully tracked and confirmed a genuinely complex three-location inventory (origin house, interim apartment drop-off, final storage unit) without losing track of which items go where.
coaching_note: Never asked the biggest-concerns agenda question — with a professional coordinator handling someone else's move, surfacing her top priorities up front (timeline pressure, weight-set fragility) could have shaped the rest of the call.
